component.name: NativMix
component.summary: Hardware-assisted volume mixer for PipeWire and PulseAudio

description.p: NativMix maps hardware controls (Arduino or MIDI) to per-application and system audio volume using PipeWire/PulseAudio on Linux.
A/B crossfader (base×gain, USB Targets control, MIDI Learn on bar); +App redesigned as Targets; label persistence; MIDI trailing CC flush.
